title: Project Hail Mary directors Phil Lord and Chris Miller reveal the 4 best sci-fi movies they've seen — and one is a John Carpenter film you've never heard of | TechRadar
summary: Project Hail Mary, directed by Phil Lord and Chris Miller, is inspired by 2001: A Space Odyssey and Dark Star among other sci-fi classics. The film is set to release with a notable cast including Ryan Gosling. It's also part of a conversation about influential sci-fi movies, with Lord and Miller sharing their top picks, including a cult classic directed by John Carpenter.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a positive discussion about influential sci-fi movies and their impact on a new film, without any strong negative market impacts.
